sections.text: Introduction

This 
 document outlines the maintenance procedure P1 which must be 
 performed every three years as indicated by Y3 in the title block to keep 
 transformer in good condition.

Most of the periodical inspections should be made in detail when the 
 transformer is de-energized.

The first draft is initiated by eng. Sherif Mahrous Omar tested by eng. Nafad 
 Kamel Mahmoud, revised by UEEPC Quality control general director eng. Gamal 
 Abd Elwahab, accepted by technical expert eng. Hassan Elbehiry and approved by 
 eng. Mohamed Gamal Diab Head sector of El-Kureimat power station.
Safety Precaution

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

sections.text: Work to be carried out
The Recommended inspection frequency is described under each inspection item.
Breather

items:
Check the discoloration of silicagel in breather due to moisture in breathed 
 air.

If the color has turned to pink by more than 2/3 of total quantity (dry out or 
 exchange it).

sections.text: Insulating oil

If the value from 0.2 
to 0.4, filter or exchange with new oil.

If the value more than 
0.4, filter or exchange with new oil (immediately).

items:
Measure dielectric strength with an oil tester and confirm it is more than 40 
 KV/2.5 mm gap.

Measure moisture content in oil with Karl-Fischer method and confirm that it 
 is less than 30 PPM.
Measure acid value and confirm it is less than 0.2 mg KOH/g

If the value from 0.2 
to 0.4, filter or exchange with new oil.

If the value more than 
0.4, filter or exchange with new oil (immediately).

If any measured values are not satisfactory filtering and degassing are 
 recommended.

sections.text:
Analysis of gas dissolved in oil 
and Resistivity measurement

items:
A periodic analysis of gas dissolved in oil is recommended every one or two 
 years.
The dissolved gas should be extracted from the oil and analyzed.

When the quantities of combustible gases are obtained we can evaluate the 
 trouble which may be present

If there is indication of moisture, sludge, low dielectric strength and low 
 resistivity, an inspection should be made on the inside of the tank for 
 possible cause of trouble.

Measure resistivity of the oil when a periodic test shows that the oil 
 is in bad 
 condition.

Measure 
 insulation resistance of motors with a 500 Kv megger, if insulation resistance 
 is less than 2 M ohm, check balancing of load currents of three phase and dry 
 out the interior of fan motors.

Check 
 the water tightness of a control box cabinet and a terminal box, if the rubber 
 gasket is worn out exchange it.

Ascertain the tightness of all control wiring connections, tighten the loose 
 bolts.

Operate 
 all switches, annunciators and lamps to observe proper functions according to 
 schematic diagram.

Measure 
 insulation resistance of cable with 500 V Megger and check any crack or 
 abrading on cable insulation.

Measure 
 insulation resistance of protective relays including their wirings with 500 V 
 Megger, when the insulation resistance is less than 2 M ohm, check dewsin the 
 terminal box .

Operation 
 tests should be made only when protective relays operated even if no troubles 
 of transformer occured.

sections.text: Connections (occasionally)

Inspect all connections outside the transformer to see whether they are in good conditions without any discoloration, 
which indicated hot connection.
